hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|py|java|go|rs)$ ]]; then echo "🔍 Code quality check for $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.py$ ]] && command -v black &> /dev/null; then echo "🎨 Auto-formatting Python file: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; black "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|ts|jsx|tsx)$ ]] && command -v prettier &> /dev/null; then echo "🎨 Auto-formatting JS/TS file: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if git rev-parse --git-dir &> /dev/null; then echo "📝 Staging file: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; git add "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|ts|py|java|go|rs)$ ]] && [[ ! "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ test|spec ]]; then echo "🧪 Remember to run tests after modifying: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|ts|py)$ ]] && command -v bandit &> /dev/null && [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.py$ ]]; then echo "🔐 Security scan for: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; bandit -r "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" -f txt 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ (package\.json|requirements\.txt|Cargo\.toml|go\.mod)$ ]]; then echo "📦 Dependency file updated: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH - Consider running dependency audit"; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|ts|py|java|go|rs)$ ]] && ! grep -q "@param\|@return\|def.*:.*\"\"\"\|//.*@" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "📖 Consider adding documentation to: $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; fi
if [[ -f "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" ]] && [[ $(wc -l < "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH") -gt 500 ]]; then echo "⚠️ Large file detected (>500 lines): $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH - Consider refactoring"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qi "performance\|optimize\|slow\|bottleneck"; then echo "🚀 Performance optimization context detected - Consider using /optimize command"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qi "architecture\|design\|scalability\|system"; then echo "🏗️ Architecture context detected - Consider using /architect command"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qi "bug\|error\|issue\|problem\|debug"; then echo "🐛 Debug context detected - Consider using /debug-deep command"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qi "refactor\|improve\|clean\|restructure"; then echo "🔧 Refactoring context detected - Consider using /refactor command"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qi "test\|testing\|coverage\|unit.*test"; then echo "🧪 Testing context detected - Consider using /test-gen command"; fi
echo "📊 Session complete. Files modified: $(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 'N/A')"
